findings.summary: The submit button appears vertically above the search input, despite following it in keyboard focus order.
findings.fix: Align the submit button with the input control's vertical position so its visual placement matches the input-then-button tab sequence.
findings.evidence: The search field occupies the first grid row including its label; the button uses align-self: end on that same row, but the screenshot shows it aligned with the label rather than the input.

passed: Search input, submit button, and archived checkbox are native form controls in DOM order, so each is reachable by Tab and the button can be activated with Enter or Space.
The archived checkbox is placed on a separate grid row after the input and submit button; this matches its later position in DOM focus order.
